parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Last machine code returned; scoped keyset pagination.

authentication.description: Configuration only; not a provider connectivity check.

availableRoles.description: Trusted active roles this account may select. Permissions apply only to the selected role.

requestId.description: Stable client retry key for one report; same key with changed content conflicts.

observedAt.description: Optional explicitly observed time; never inferred from imported data.

investigationOutcome.description: INVESTIGATION submit only; required. Maintenance/sensor follow-up outcomes also require preventiveAction with next steps.

technicianId.description: assign only; active in-org technician with machine grant

reason.description: Required for return and for reassignment; 3–4,000 characters.

rootCause.description: Required on BREAKDOWN submit only; human RCA, 3–4,000 characters. Rejected for planned maintenance and investigations.

correctiveAction.description: Required on submit; corrective action for breakdowns, checks/work performed for planned maintenance and investigations; 3–4,000 characters.

preventiveAction.description: Required on BREAKDOWN submit; optional planned/investigation follow-up (mandatory for maintenance/sensor investigation outcomes); 3–4,000 characters when provided.

restoredAt.description: BREAKDOWN submit only; explicit offset timestamp between report and submission. Rejected for planned maintenance and investigations.

performedAt.description: PLANNED/INVESTIGATION submission only; explicit completion time between creation and submission. Findings/work performed are required; breakdown RCA/restoration fields are rejected.

note.description: approve/close only; optional 3–4,000-character note. Extra fields for each action are rejected.

firstDueAt.description: Explicit offset timestamp; recurrence follows Asia/Kolkata fixed calendar dates. Monthly anchor days clamp without drifting.
Explicit offset timestamp; recurrence follows Asia/Kolkata fixed calendar dates. Monthly anchor days clamp without drifting.

technicianId.description: Optional explicit combined review/open action for INVESTIGATE; otherwise open from the saved review. Rejected for dismissals.
Active technician with machine access. Exact retries return the existing order; reassignment uses the versioned order action.
